<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 350" width="500" height="350">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Inclined Plane and Pulley Setup -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 250)">
    <!-- Ground line for incline -->
    <line x1="-20" y1="0" x2="200" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
    
    <!-- Incline (30 degrees, length ~ 230) -->
    <!-- cos(30) * 230 ≈ 199.2, sin(30) * 230 = 115 -->
    <polygon points="0,0 200,0 200,-115" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Hatching for inclined plane -->
    <line x1="30" y1="0" x2="20" y2="-10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="60" y1="0" x2="50" y2="-10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="90" y1="0" x2="80" y2="-10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="120" y1="0" x2="110" y2="-10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="150" y1="0" x2="140" y2="-10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <line x1="180" y1="0" x2="170" y2="-10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- 30 degree angle arc -->
    <path d="M 40 0 A 40 40 0 0 0 34.64 -20" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="48" y="-10" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14" font-style="italic">30°</text>

    <!-- Block on incline (mass 4.0 kg) -->
    <!-- Positioned along incline. Let's place center at distance 100 up the incline -->
    <!-- Center: x = 100 * cos(30) ≈ 86.6, y = -100 * sin(30) = -50 -->
    <!-- We want a rotated square. Angle of incline is 30 deg. -->
    <g transform="translate(86.6, -50) rotate(-30)">
      <rect x="-20" y="-20" width="40" height="40" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="0" y="5" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">4.0 kg</text>
    </g>

    <!-- String from block up to pulley -->
    <!-- Block top-right corner along incline:
         Center is at (86.6, -50). Top edge is at y' = -20 in block coords.
         In world coords, top edge runs from x = 86.6 + 20*sin(30) ... let's just connect from block top-right to pulley. -->
    <!-- Pulley at top of incline: (200, -115) -->
    <!-- Block top-right roughly at (86.6 + 17.3, -50 - 10) = (103.9, -60) -->
    <line x1="104" y1="-60" x2="200" y2="-115" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Pulley -->
    <circle cx="200" cy="-115" r="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="200" cy="-115" r="2" fill="#000000" />
    <!-- Pulley mount -->
    <line x1="200" y1="-115" x2="200" y2="-130" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Hanging mass (3.0 kg) -->
    <!-- String from pulley down: x = 200, y from -115 to -45 -->
    <line x1="200" y1="-115" x2="200" y2="-45" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <rect x="185" y="-45" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="200" y="-26" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">3.0 kg</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Fig. 1.1 label -->
  <text x="250" y="325" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 1.1</text>
</svg>
